headline: Job listing suggests Apple is building its own AI agent
summary: A job listing spotted by Bloomberg suggests Apple is working on its own agentic AI assistant that could browse the web, work across apps, write code and call services. Outlets differ on the seniority of the role described: one says Apple seeks an engineer to lead the project, another says it is a senior engineering manager role. One outlet also uniquely frames the project as an agent that would run the user's Mac and compete with named rivals.
